consent.title: Shuru karne se pehle
consent.intro: Padhiye ki Medicos aapki health jaankari ka kaise use karta hai.
consent.collectBody: Aapka naam, umar, gender, sheher, mobile number, aur aap hamare assistant ko apni sehat ke baare mein jo batate hain, saath mein aapki upload ki hui photo aur report.
consent.whyBody: Sirf aapke chune hue doctor ke liye aapki history ka summary banane ke liye, taaki visit jaldi ho aur kuch na chhoote. Assistant bimaari nahi batata aur dawa nahi likhta.
consent.whoBody: Aap, aur sirf woh doctor jinke saath aap share karein (aur unka clinic staff), usi visit ke liye. Hum aapka data bechte nahi aur AI sikhane mein use nahi karte.
consent.keepBody: Jab tak aap apna account delete nahi karte. Billing records sirf utna jitna kaanoon kehta hai.
consent.deleteBody: Settings mein kabhi bhi dekhiye ki records kisne khole, access wapas lijiye, apna data download kijiye ya account delete kijiye.
consent.agree: Maine yeh padh liya hai aur main sehmat hoon
consent.mustAgree: Aage badhne ke liye box par tick karein.
